_about: What the-agent-kit's session-start check suggests when missing. The installer copies this to ~/.the-agent-kit/recommended.json once and never overwrites it: delete an entry there to stop it being suggested, add your own to be reminded of them. 'when': 'always', or 'web' for projects whose AGENTS.md block marks a web or user-facing platform. Per tool, 'mcp', 'plugin' or 'skill' names what must be present. Details: ~/.the-agent-kit/docs/environment-setup-prompt.md

claude.install: claude mcp add --transport http context7 https://mcp.context7.com/mcp --scope user --header "Authorization: Bearer <your-context7-key>"

items.name: Playwright CLI skill (drive the UI in a real browser)
